topics.description: Taco Bell is under investigation for its potential link to a cyclosporiasis outbreak. The outbreak has caused widespread illness and Taco Bell is cooperating with authorities.
The Trump administration has ended its attempt to freeze $10 billion in federal funds for blue states. The move was met with criticism from various parties.
The Department of Homeland Security is embroiled in a fraud saga as its Deputy Commissioner retires. The agency is under scrutiny for its handling of funds.
